data.description:
EXPERIENCE THE DEMO FOR ROGUE PINATAS: VRMAGEDDON!

A multiplayer VR roguelite game. Your mission? Survive the party-apocalyptic world by bashing your way through swarms of invading Piñatas, where every swing could mean survival or sweet defeat!

FULL GAME FEATURES:

*Quest 2 supporting coming soon!

6+ Different Characters to Choose: 
As one of the few party-apocalyptic survivors, it’s up to you to answer the call!

12+ Weapons to Master: 
Master creative and diabolical weapons for both close-quarter and long-ranged fights.

17+ Ingenious Gadgets: 
Discover and unlock a wide range of wild gadgets to help you survive the chaos. Combine Gadgets with some Weapons for new Evo Weapons!

Online Multiplayer: 
Play solo or team up with friends in an intense cooperative multiplayer mode, where you'll need to work together to survive the relentless onslaught of piñatas.

30+ Piñata Enemies: 
These piñatas have different behaviors, actions, and a few deadly tricks as the Piñata invasion gets smarter and harder across the different Stages.

6+ Piñata Bosses: 
Insanely big and monstrous Mega Piñatas will challenge even the most skilled party of fighters. Bring your A game, or A team, if you want to succeed.

6+ World-Ending Locations: 
From your local neighborhood to the treacherous mysteries of the desert, each area offers new dangers and opportunities for mayhem.

Hidden Secrets: 
Find secrets in every Stage by looking high and low, and listening well.
